summary: Station model-list adapters must register selectable presets idempotently, use page auth without storing credentials, normalize rows as CREDITS, preserve tier intervals, and keep unsupported billing modes in partial diagnostics.

Existing page-mode providers use requestPolicy plus localStoragePageAuth; all-in-one should read tenant_access_token in the page context and send a Bearer Authorization header without extension credentials.
Existing model-plaza strategies convert token prices to per-million values, preserve tier rows, map request/image billing explicitly, and emit unsupported/invalid/unpriced diagnostics.

Core tests cover provider matching, page bridge auth, station preset idempotency, normalized price fields, diagnostics, and CREDITS collection semantics; extend these patterns with redacted all-in-one fixtures.
Verified page-session API: GET /api/tenant/models with tenant_access_token Bearer auth returns code 0 and data.list models containing token and tiered pricing fields.
